chapters.title: Introduction - Comparing GP and Business Central
Entering credit memos in Dynamics GP

Entering credit memos in Business Central using sales journals

features.name: Receivables transaction entry in Dynamics GP
features.description: Enter invoices for services provided to customers by selecting customer, entering amount, and posting the invoice using the receivables transaction entry window.

features.name: Credit memo application in Dynamics GP
features.description: Enter credit memos for customers and apply them to original invoices using the apply sales document window to select outstanding invoices.

features.name: Sales journals for receivables invoices in Business Central
features.description: Create receivables invoices in Business Central by navigating to sales journals, creating batches with default sales accounts, selecting document type of invoice, entering customer information and amounts, with ability to preview GL entries before posting.

features.name: Credit memos in sales journals in Business Central
features.description: Enter credit memos in Business Central using sales journal batches with separate number series, select credit memo document type, apply to invoices using apply entry process, and post the document.

features.name: Sales invoices document in Business Central
features.description: Create sales invoices in Business Central as an alternative to sales journals, allowing tracking of services and items, with ability to include GL accounts and inventory items on the same transaction for combined billing.
